title: The walkthroughs promise to run end to end and open on a repo the reader does not have
foundBy: session agent, walking README.md and INSTALL.md as a first-time reader

evidence.verified: Read against the eight walkthrough blocks: five name a path under ~/projects, and nothing before them creates or introduces one.

details:
The README introduces its walkthroughs with "Each block is runnable end to end". Every block that shares a repo names `~/projects/api`, `~/projects/web` or `~/projects/bench`, which are the reader's to supply and are described nowhere. A reader who copies the first block gets a path error on their first command.

The writing rules ask that every example be runnable as written, and that a reader never meet a file they were not given. One sentence in the introduction resolves it without turning the walkthroughs into a setup guide.
